notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 named object-registration surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies ordinary and multiple object-instance name reservation, release and reuse, named registration and identity lookups, reservation contention, the unreserved-name negative boundary, discovery, and standard resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-instance name reservation and named registration services with FederateAmbassador reservation and discovery callbacks
